questions.text: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was purpose-built as the capital in 1913, settling the rivalry between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.text: What is the longest river in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile is about 6,650 km long, though some measurements credit the Amazon.

questions.text: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: Germany surrendered in May 1945 and Japan in September 1945.

questions.text: Who was the first President of the United States?

questions.explanation: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa in the early 16th century.

questions.text: Who wrote the play 'Romeo and Juliet'?
Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers about 63 million square miles.

questions.text: How many continents are there on Earth?
questions.explanation: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia, Europe, North America, and South America.
